title: Intentional Rounding in Internal Medicine
brief_summary: Each investigator will have to collect data for 50 hospitalized patients in the Internal Medicine wards. If the center is randomized to Intentional Rounding, the staff of nurses and OSS will have to implement the new care strategy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Signature of informed consent
* Patients who understand Italian

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who deny informed consent
